VW was required to bring the vehicles into a legally compliant state at its own expense. This was the more effective solution in the interest of the customer.
context: The court justifying the remedial recall approach over punitive sanctions as serving the higher principle of proportionality and customer interest.

label: Test results showed no auffälligkeiten for VW models
original_label: Test results showed no auffälligkeiten for VW models
quote: Es gab für das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt in keinem Typgenehmigungsverfahren einen Hinweis darauf, dass eine Abschalteinrichtung vorhanden sein könnte. Die Einhaltung der Emissionsgrenzwerte im NEFZ Typ 1 ist Voraussetzung für eine Typgenehmigung. Die mit dem Antrag vom jeweiligen Hersteller beim Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt vorgelegten Prüfberichte wiesen hierzu keine Auffälligkeiten aus. Zudem hat der TÜV Nord bestätigt, dass im Rahmen der Typgenehmigungsprüfungen keine auffälligen Grenzwertüberschreitungen festgestellt wurden. Dies gilt auch für die mit einer unzulässigen Abschalteinrichtung ausgestatteten Fahrzeuge des VW-Konzerns.
english_gloss: There was no indication in any type approval procedure for the Federal Motor Transport Authority that a shut-off device might be present. Compliance with NEFZ Type 1 emission limits is a requirement for type approval. The test reports submitted by the respective manufacturer to the Federal Motor Transport Authority showed no irregularities. Furthermore, TÜV Nord confirmed that no conspicuous limit value exceedances were found during type approval testing. This also applies to VW Group vehicles equipped with unlawful shut-off devices.
context: The court explaining why test records showed no red flags even for vehicles later found to have illegal devices.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Regulator bound to prescribed test procedure
original_label: Regulator bound to prescribed test procedure
quote: Als Verwaltungsbehörde war das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt aber dazu gehalten, sich auf das von den europäischen Vorschriften vorgegebene 'Typprüfkorsett' zu beschränken. Bis zum Inkrafttreten des auf europäischer Ebene am 14. Juni 2016 beschlossenen neuen Prüfverfahrens WLTP im September 2017 war und ist der NEFZ das verbindliche Prüfverfahren, auf das auch die geltenden Grenzwerte bezogen sind.
english_gloss: As an administrative authority, the Federal Motor Transport Authority was required to restrict itself to the 'type test framework' specified by European regulations. Until the new WLTP test procedure adopted at European level on 14 June 2016 came into force in September 2017, and is, NEFZ the binding test procedure to which the applicable limit values are also related.
context: The court explaining that the regulator was legally bound to use only the prescribed test procedure and could not unilaterally modify it.

label: Regulations require European-level coordination, not national action
original_label: Regulations require European-level coordination, not national action
quote: Sowohl mit Blick auf unterschiedliche Kraftfahrzeughersteller wie auch mit Blick auf die anderen Typgenehmigungsbehörden der EU-Mitgliedstaaten wären einseitige Veränderungen einer Typgenehmigungsbehörde am vorgeschriebenen Prüfverfahren nach Auffassung des Ausschusses ein keinesfalls zu tolerierender Wettbewerbsverstoß.
english_gloss: In the view of the committee, unilateral changes to the prescribed test procedure by a type approval authority would be an absolutely intolerable competition violation both with regard to different motor vehicle manufacturers and with regard to the other type approval authorities of the EU member states.
context: The court explaining why a single nation cannot unilaterally change test procedures without coordinating at European level.

label: Software source code not required to be disclosed without grounds
original_label: Software source code not required to be disclosed without grounds
quote: Es gab für das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt in keinem Typgenehmigungsverfahren einen Hinweis darauf, dass eine Abschalteinrichtung vorhanden sein könnte... Erst der von VW eingeräumte Verstoß lieferte einen gefestigten Verdacht, um zur Gefahrenabwehr nach dem Amtsermittlungsgrundsatz dem Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt im Auftrag der Untersuchungskommission 'Volkswagen' ausnahmsweise tieferen Einblick in entsprechende Software zu geben. Die rechtliche Grundlage hierfür musste das Bundesverkehrsministerium per Erlass schaffen, da es außerhalb einer solchen Untersuchung aus besonderem Anlass für eine Offenlegung derart sicherheitskritischer Software einer für alle EU-Typgenehmigungsbehörden gleichermaßen verbindlichen Grundlage im europäischen Recht bedarf, welche es bis heute nicht gibt.
english_gloss: There was no indication in any type approval procedure for the Federal Motor Transport Authority that a shut-off device might be present... Only VW's admission of the violation provided a solid basis for suspicion to give the Federal Motor Transport Authority, on behalf of the investigation committee 'Volkswagen', exceptional deeper insight into the corresponding software on the grounds of hazard prevention and official investigative authority. The legal basis for this had to be created by the Federal Ministry of Transport by decree, because outside such an investigation on special grounds, disclosure of such safety-critical software requires a legal basis in European law equally binding on all EU type approval authorities, which does not exist to this day.
context: The court explaining why software could not be demanded without specific grounds, and how VW's admission created exceptional legal basis for inspection.

label: Technical optimization for test cycle standard practice
original_label: Technical optimization for test cycle standard practice
quote: Der Sachverständige Prof. Dr. Hausberger fasste treffend zusammen, dass sich die Experten eigentlich sicher waren, dass der NEFZ so schlecht sei, dass man nicht zusätzlich noch abschalten müsse.
english_gloss: Expert Prof. Dr. Hausberger aptly summarized that experts were actually confident that the NEFZ was so poor that one did not need to shut down additionally.
context: Expert testimony explaining that test cycle optimization was so standard that experts did not suspect additional manipulation.

label: Seven-fold emission divergence attributed to NEFZ not manipulation
original_label: Seven-fold emission divergence attributed to NEFZ not manipulation
quote: Selbst auffällig hohe Messwertabweichungen um das siebenfache ließen jedoch keinen Rückschluss auf eine Manipulation der Abgasregulierung zur Einhaltung der Grenzwerte im Rahmen der Emissionsprüfung zu. Diese Abweichungen wurden vor September 2015 einhellig von allen Zeugen und Sachverständigen auf die vielfältigen Schwächen des gesetzlich vorgeschriebenen NEFZ Typ 1 zurückgeführt.
english_gloss: Even conspicuously high measurement value deviations of up to seven-fold did not, however, allow any conclusion about manipulation of emission control to meet limit values in the context of emission testing. Before September 2015, all witnesses and experts unanimously attributed these deviations to the numerous weaknesses of the legally prescribed NEFZ Type 1.
context: The court noting that even extreme test divergences were uniformly attributed to known test procedure defects, not to manipulation.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Regulations were compliant; no legal violation occurred
original_label: Regulations were compliant; no legal violation occurred
quote: Das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt und der beauftragte Technische Dienst haben im Rahmen der geltenden Vorschriften geprüft, um im Ergebnis einen Verwaltungsakt zu erlassen, der auch rechtlich Bestand hat und sämtlichen rechtlichen Anforderungen entspricht.
english_gloss: The Motor Vehicle Authority and the commissioned Technical Service examined within the framework of the applicable regulations in order to issue an administrative act that has legal standing and meets all legal requirements.
context: The Bundestag committee majority defending the Federal Motor Vehicle Authority's (KBA) actions, asserting that they acted lawfully within the applicable regulations.

label: Defects in EU regulation, not KBA responsibility
original_label: Defects in EU regulation, not KBA responsibility
quote: Mängel einer rechtskonformen Prüfung in Folge defizitärer Prüfprozeduren oder Regelungen können nach Auffassung des Ausschusses nicht zu Lasten der prüfenden Stellen gehen, sondern erfordern eine Korrektur der europäischen Rechtslage.
english_gloss: According to the committee's view, defects in compliant examination procedures as a result of deficient testing procedures or regulations cannot be borne by the examining authorities, but rather require correction of the EU legal framework.
context: The committee majority argues that defects in testing procedures or regulations cannot be blamed on the examining authorities but require correction at the EU level.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: NEFZ procedure was legally mandatory; no alternative was permitted
original_label: NEFZ procedure was legally mandatory; no alternative was permitted
quote: Wie bei der Typgenehmigung fehlte auch hier die rechtliche Grundlage und Testprozedur, vom NEFZ abweichende, ergänzende Prüfungen "freihändig" vorzunehmen.
english_gloss: As with type approval, here too the legal basis and test procedure were lacking to carry out supplementary tests deviating from NEFZ on an ad hoc basis.
context: The committee majority justifies why the KBA did not conduct additional testing outside the NEFZ procedure, claiming no legal basis existed for such alternative tests.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: KBA lacked concrete evidence or suspicious indicators
original_label: KBA lacked concrete evidence or suspicious indicators
quote: Nach dem Ergebnis der Beweisaufnahme lagen den zuständigen Stellen konkrete Manipulationshinweise nicht vor. Der Ausschuss ist nach dem Ergebnis der Beweisaufnahme von einem durchgängig gesetzeskonformen Verwaltungshandeln sowohl des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes als auch der Technischen Dienste überzeugt.
english_gloss: According to the results of the hearing, the responsible authorities did not have concrete indications of manipulation. Based on the hearing results, the committee is convinced of consistently lawful administrative action by both the Motor Vehicle Authority and the Technical Services.
context: The committee majority concludes that the responsible authorities had no concrete evidence of manipulation and acted lawfully throughout.

label: Accusations of state negligence lack foundation
original_label: Accusations of state negligence lack foundation
quote: Der kontinuierlich erhobene Vorwurf der Opposition, es handele sich beim Abgasskandal um einen Fall von "Staatsversagen", hat sich für den Ausschuss in jeder Hinsicht als PR-Floskel ohne jegliche Grundlage herausgestellt.
english_gloss: The continually raised accusation by the opposition that the emissions scandal was a case of 'state failure' has proven to be, in every respect, a PR platitude without any foundation.
context: The committee majority dismisses the opposition's claims of state failure as mere public relations rhetoric without basis.

label: Vague EU regulations prevented KBA action
original_label: Vague EU regulations prevented KBA action
quote: Die nach dem 18. September 2015 geäußerte Kritik der Bundesregierung, die Regelungen zu Abschalteinrichtungen und deren Erkennung seien zu unklar gefasst, sodass ein Einschreiten gegen die Verwendung von Abschalteinrichtung nicht möglich gewesen wäre, wird durch die aktuelle Anwendung von Testverfahren außerhalb des normierten Prüfzyklus durch die Untersuchungskommission "Volkswagen" widerlegt.
english_gloss: The criticism expressed by the federal government after September 18, 2015, that the regulations on defeat devices and their detection were too vaguely formulated, so that intervention against the use of defeat devices would not have been possible, is contradicted by the current application of test procedures outside the standardized test cycle by the 'Volkswagen' investigation commission.
context: The LEFT faction challenges the government's post-scandal excuse that unclear regulations prevented action, noting the investigation commission used alternative testing methods.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Acting within the statutory framework meant no wrongdoing
original_label: Acting within the statutory framework meant no wrongdoing
quote: Das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt prüft fortlaufend im Rahmen von Konformitätsprüfungen (CoP-P-Prüfungen), ob und wie die Fahrzeughersteller ihrer gesetzlichen Selbstverpflichtung nachkommen. Hierbei setzt das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt grundsätzlich auf der Prüfdokumentation des Herstellers auf.
english_gloss: The Motor Vehicle Authority continuously examines through conformity reviews whether and how vehicle manufacturers comply with their statutory self-obligation. In this process, the Motor Vehicle Authority generally relies on the testing documentation of the manufacturer.
context: The committee majority describes how the KBA verified compliance using manufacturer documentation within the legal framework established for such reviews.

category: Moral justification and appeal to higher loyalties
label: Rapid international standards required in interest of industry
original_label: Rapid international standards required in interest of industry
quote: Mit Hilfe dieser neuen Prüfverfahren ist zu erwarten, dass die Verwendung illegaler Abschalteinrichtungen für die Hersteller deutlich erschwert und so wirtschaftlich unattraktiv wird. Diese Prüfverfahren sind unmittelbare Reaktion auf das allgemein bekannte Auseinanderfallen von Realemissionen und auf dem Rollenprüfstand gemessenen Emissionen.
english_gloss: With the help of these new testing procedures, it is to be expected that the use of illegal defeat devices will be considerably more difficult for manufacturers and thus economically unattractive. These testing procedures are a direct reaction to the commonly known divergence between real-world emissions and emissions measured on the test stand.
context: The committee majority justifies EU regulatory changes as necessary to protect industry viability through modernized procedures rather than regulatory crackdowns.

label: EU lacks clear definitions; KBA cannot act without them
original_label: EU lacks clear definitions; KBA cannot act without them
quote: Eine enge Auslegung des Ausnahmetatbestandes von weit mehr Sachverständigen vertreten als die Auffassung der Bundesregierung, unter anderem vom Wissenschaftlichen Dienst des Deutschen Bundstages und dem Sachverständigen Prof. Dr. Klinger. Daher ist die Kritik der Vertreter der Bundesregierung an der angeblichen Unbestimmtheit der Regelungen zu Abschalteinrichtungen vorgeschoben, denn sie war gewollt.
english_gloss: A narrow interpretation of the exception is represented by far more experts than the view of the federal government, including the Scientific Service of the German Bundestag and expert Prof. Dr. Klinger. Therefore, the criticism by representatives of the federal government regarding the alleged vagueness of the regulations on defeat devices is pretextual, because it was deliberate.
context: The LEFT faction argues the government's claims of regulatory ambiguity are pretextual, as many experts favor strict interpretation and the ambiguity was deliberately chosen.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: High-level officials claim ignorance of manipulation indicators
original_label: High-level officials claim ignorance of manipulation indicators
quote: Wie auch bei den Stickoxidemissionen lässt sich die Diskrepanz auf verschiedene Ursachen zurückführen: einerseits ein unzureichender Fahrzyklus, Toleranzen sowie Flexibilitäten im Messverfahren und beim Prüffahrzeug und andererseits ein individuelles Fahrverhalten und der Zustand des Fahrzeugs im Realbetrieb. Hieraus lässt sich jedoch keinesfalls schlussfolgern, dass die im Rahmen der Typgenehmigung ermittelten Werte fehlerhaft sind.
english_gloss: As with nitrogen oxide emissions, the discrepancy can be traced back to various causes: on the one hand insufficient driving cycles, tolerances and flexibilities in the test procedure and test vehicle, and on the other hand individual driving behavior and the condition of the vehicle in real-world operation. However, it cannot be concluded from this that the values determined in the context of type approval are incorrect.
context: The committee majority argues that discrepancies between lab and real-world emissions have multiple technical causes unrelated to manipulation.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Monitoring system existed; no violations were detected
original_label: Monitoring system existed; no violations were detected
quote: Das von Umweltverbänden behauptete Fehlen jeglicher amtlichen Kontrolle der CO2-Werte ist falsch. Die in den Kraftfahrzeugherstellerangaben veröffentlichten CO2-Werte werden nach der Verordnung (EG) Nr. 715/2007 im Rahmen der Emissionsmessungen im Typgenehmigungsverfahren von den Technischen Diensten bestimmt.
english_gloss: The claim by environmental organizations that there is a complete absence of official CO2 monitoring is false. The CO2 values published in the vehicle manufacturer specifications are determined in accordance with Regulation (EC) No. 715/2007 as part of emission measurements in the type approval procedure by the Technical Services.
context: The committee majority defends the monitoring system as adequate and denies the environmental groups' claims of absent controls.

label: No state revenue loss from manipulation; no consumer taxes increased
original_label: No state revenue loss from manipulation; no consumer taxes increased
quote: Sowohl die Behauptung, dem Staat seien durch Manipulationen der Abgasminderung oder der CO2-Werte Mindereinnahmen entstanden als auch der Vorwurf, im Zusammenhang mit dem Abgasskandal kämen auf die Halterinnen und Halter höhere Steuerbelastungen zu, sind bis dato nach dem Ergebnis der Beweisaufnahme eindeutig falsch.
english_gloss: Both the claim that the state suffered revenue losses from manipulation of emissions reduction or CO2 values, and the accusation that vehicle owners face higher tax burdens as a result of the emissions scandal, are according to the results of the hearing clearly false.
context: The committee majority denies that the state suffered tax losses or that vehicle owners faced increased taxes due to the scandal.

label: Complex motorsteuerung makes detection without concrete evidence impossible
original_label: Complex motorsteuerung makes detection without concrete evidence impossible
quote: Es liegt noch kein hinreichendes Erfahrungswissen vor, um eventuelle ungewollte Härten oder gar Fehlentwicklungen durch die konkrete Ausgestaltung der RDE-Gesetzgebung auszuschließen. Der Ausschuss begrüßt deshalb die derzeitige Festlegung der Transferfunktion auf den Faktor 1, die absichert, dass die Transferfunktion ohne wissenschaftliche Evidenz nicht zum Tragen kommt.
english_gloss: There is not yet sufficient knowledge from experience to rule out any unintended hardships or even misguided developments through the concrete design of RDE legislation. The committee therefore welcomes the current definition of the transfer function at factor 1, which ensures that the transfer function does not come into play without scientific evidence.
context: The committee majority suggests that without sufficient experience and scientific evidence, authorities cannot be expected to detect regulatory violations.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: KBA unaware of defeat device concept until September 2015
original_label: KBA unaware of defeat device concept until September 2015
quote: Dass allerdings dem Leiter des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes die Begrifflichkeit bis September 2015 völlig unbekannt gewesen sei, ist schwer nachvollziehbar. Das Verbot zum Einsatz von Abschalteinrichtungen existierte bereits in der Vorgängervorschrift und stellte also weder ein "Novum" in der Verordnung (EG) Nr. 715/2007 dar, noch war es bis zum 19. September 2015 Gegenstand des Fachaustauschs mit den Herstellern, den Technischen Diensten oder den Genehmigungsbehörden anderer Mitgliedstaaten.
english_gloss: However, that the head of the Motor Vehicle Authority should have been completely unfamiliar with the concept until September 2015 is difficult to understand. The prohibition on the use of defeat devices already existed in the predecessor regulation and thus represented neither a novelty in Regulation (EC) No. 715/2007, nor was it until September 19, 2015 a subject of technical discussion with manufacturers, technical services, or approval authorities of other member states.
context: The LEFT faction challenges the KBA leader's claimed ignorance of defeat devices, noting the prohibition existed in prior regulations and should have been discussed professionally.

category: Moral justification and appeal to higher loyalties
label: Balancing environmental protection with industry competitiveness
original_label: Balancing environmental protection with industry competitiveness
quote: Der Ausschuss erkennt an, dass sich Deutschland für verhältnismäßig strenge Konformitätsfaktoren eingesetzt hat und diese auch durchsetzen konnte. Auf Ebene der Bundesregierung hatten sich die zuständigen Ressorts auf einen Wert geeinigt, da Deutschland in Brüssel mit einer Stimme spricht. Es nehmen aber 28 Mitgliedstaaten an den Verhandlungen teil, von denen manche Autoindustrie beherbergen, andere nicht. Ziel war es, einen sowohl klimapolitisch anspruchsvollen als auch pragmatisch und technisch umsetzbaren Faktor zu finden, auf den man sich einigen konnte.
english_gloss: The committee recognizes that Germany has advocated for relatively strict conformity factors and has been able to enforce them. At the federal government level, the responsible departments agreed on a value because Germany speaks with one voice in Brussels. However, 28 member states participate in the negotiations, some of which have a significant automotive industry and others do not. The goal was to find a factor that was both climatically ambitious and pragmatically and technically feasible, on which agreement could be reached.
context: The committee majority justifies Germany's negotiating position on EU emissions standards as balancing environmental ambition with technical feasibility and industry viability.

label: EU Parliament investigation's conclusions mischaracterize state obligations
original_label: EU Parliament investigation's conclusions mischaracterize state obligations
quote: Unter diesem Gesichtspunkt verwundert die Feststellung des EMIS-Untersuchungsausschusses, die Mitgliedstaaten hätten durch das Versäumnis, ein wirksames Marktüberwachungssystem zu organisieren, gegen europäisches Recht verstoßen. Nach der geltenden Rechtslage war ein solches nicht vorgeschrieben und wäre angesichts des Regelungsvorrangs des europäischen Rechts unzulässig gewesen.
english_gloss: From this perspective, the finding of the EMIS investigation committee that member states violated European law by failing to organize an effective market surveillance system is surprising. Under the applicable law, such a system was not prescribed and would have been impermissible given the primacy of European law.
context: The committee majority rejects the EU Parliament's EMIS investigation findings as legally incorrect regarding state obligations for market surveillance.

label: Hersteller-freundliche interpretation required by regulation ambiguity
original_label: Hersteller-freundliche interpretation required by regulation ambiguity
quote: Erst ein Satz dieser notwendigen Überarbeitung der Rechtslage ist mit dem Wechsel des vorgeschriebenen Prüfverfahrens von NEFZ auf die WLTP sowie den Abschlüssen des ersten und zweiten RDE-Pakets bereits erfolgt.
english_gloss: A first step of this necessary overhaul of the legal framework has already been taken with the switch from the prescribed NEFZ testing procedure to WLTP and the conclusion of the first and second RDE packages.
context: The committee majority argues that regulatory improvement has already begun, suggesting that addressing prior ambiguities was outside KBA's authority.

label: Emission mitigation strategies rather than illegal defeat devices
original_label: Emission mitigation strategies rather than illegal defeat devices
quote: Im Ergebnis ist die Abschaltung der Abgasrückführung nach 22 Minuten und die Abschaltung der Regeneration des NOx-Speicherkatalysators nach sechs Zyklen festgestellt worden. Die zeitabhängige Herabregelung des Emissionskontrollsystems entspricht nach Einschätzung der Untersuchungskommission und des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes einer unzulässigen Abschalteinrichtung, da sich ein solches Verfahren mit den Regeln über den Motorschutz nicht zwingend erklären lässt.
english_gloss: As a result, the deactivation of exhaust gas recirculation after 22 minutes and the deactivation of NOx storage catalyst regeneration after six cycles has been determined. According to the assessment of the investigation commission and the Motor Vehicle Authority, the time-dependent reduction of the emission control system corresponds to an impermissible defeat device, since such a procedure cannot necessarily be explained by the rules on engine protection.
context: The investigation commission describes defeat device behavior using technical terminology ('emission mitigation strategies,' 'time-dependent reduction') rather than plainly labeling them as fraud.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Manufacturers followed recognized test procedures and standards
original_label: Manufacturers followed recognized test procedures and standards
quote: Nach Bestätigung des TÜV Nord sind die CO2-Emissionsmessungen im Rahmen der Typgenehmigung streng und herstellerunabhängig entsprechend dem vorgeschriebenen gesetzlichen Fahrzyklus (NEFZ Typ 1) erfolgt. Ein unterstelltes "Herunterprüfen" der Verbrauchswerte hat nicht stattgefunden.
english_gloss: According to confirmation by TÜV Nord, CO2 emissions measurements in the context of type approval were conducted strictly and independently in accordance with the prescribed legal driving cycle (NEFZ Type 1). An alleged 'downward testing' of consumption values did not take place.
context: The committee majority cites third-party verification that emissions testing followed required legal procedures, denying manipulation allegations.

category: Moral justification and appeal to higher loyalties
label: Protecting workers and industrial competitiveness justified regulatory forbearance
original_label: Protecting workers and industrial competitiveness justified regulatory forbearance
quote: Der Ausschuss erachtet es als eine selbstverständliche Verpflichtung der für die Standorte von Fahrzeugherstellern politischen Verantwortlichen, drohenden Beeinträchtigungen der Wettbewerbsfähigkeit der Betriebe entgegenzuwirken.
english_gloss: The committee considers it an obvious duty of those politically responsible for vehicle manufacturer sites to counteract any threatening impairments to the competitiveness of these enterprises.
context: The committee majority suggests that policymakers have a duty to protect industrial competitiveness, implicitly justifying forbearance toward manufacturers.

label: Only EU-level harmonization could have prevented scandal
original_label: Only EU-level harmonization could have prevented scandal
quote: Der Handlungsspielraum der Bundesregierung zur Beseitigung der Differenz zwischen den auf Prüfständen und den im Realbetrieb ermittelten Emissions- und Verbrauchswerten und deren Ursachen ist demgemäß auf die Fortentwicklung des anwendbaren Europarechts beschränkt.
english_gloss: The action space of the federal government to address the difference between emissions and consumption values determined on test stands versus in real-world operation and their causes is accordingly limited to the further development of applicable European law.
context: The committee majority restricts its analysis to EU-level solutions, suggesting German authorities lacked independent authority to address emissions discrepancies.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: No indication from DUH that hints constituted concrete evidence
original_label: No indication from DUH that hints constituted concrete evidence
quote: Die Beweisaufnahme hat dabei aber klar ergeben, dass im Zuge der Anhörungen und des Fachaustauschs vor September 2015 nie konkrete Hinweise auf Manipulationen wie bei VW zur Sprache gekommen sind. Weder fand sich in den vom Ausschuss angeforderten Akten noch ergab sich aus den Zeugenbefragungen ein Beleg für die Behauptung der Deutschen Umwelthilfe (DUH) sowie ihres Experten, dem Zeugen Dr. Friedrich, bereits 2011 eindeutig auf Manipulationen an Emissionsminderungseinrichtungen hingewiesen zu haben.
english_gloss: However, the hearing clearly showed that during the hearings and expert exchanges before September 2015, no concrete indications of manipulation such as those involving VW were ever raised. Neither in the files requested by the committee nor in the witness interrogations was there evidence for the assertion by the German Environmental Association (DUH) and its expert, witness Dr. Friedrich, that they had clearly pointed to manipulations of emission reduction equipment as early as 2011.
context: The committee majority dismisses environmental NGO warnings as lacking 'concrete' evidence, setting an impossibly high evidentiary bar.

label: No health or environmental damage proven from NOx variance
original_label: No health or environmental damage proven from NOx variance
quote: Ohnedies sei die Kausalität von Stickoxid-Fahrzeugemissionen für Schädigungen der menschlichen Gesundheit und das Leben nicht erwiesen.
english_gloss: In any case, the causality of nitrogen oxide vehicle emissions for damage to human health and life has not been proven.
context: The committee majority implies that without direct causal proof linking specific vehicle models to health outcomes, emissions violations should not be treated as harmful.

label: Strategic regulatory positioning rather than capture or bias
original_label: Strategic regulatory positioning rather than capture or bias
quote: Besonders betont wurde, dass Gespräche der Bundesregierung mit Vertretern der Automobilindustrie nicht darauf angelegt waren, gemeinsam eine Position zu vereinbaren, sondern die bereits bestehende Position der Bundesregierung über technische Detailinformationen und Anforderungen zu verifizieren.
english_gloss: It was particularly emphasized that discussions of the federal government with representatives of the automotive industry were not designed to jointly agree on a position, but rather to verify the already existing position of the federal government through technical detailed information and requirements.
context: The committee majority sanitizes industry meetings as mere 'verification' of positions rather than acknowledging industry influence on regulatory development.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Thermofenster practice was within bounds of law
original_label: Thermofenster practice was within bounds of law
quote: Ob den Kunden zusätzliche vertragliche Rechte wie Schadensersatz zustehen, unterliegt der zivilgerichtlichen Klärung und entzieht sich dem Einfluss der Bundesregierung.
english_gloss: Whether customers are entitled to additional contractual rights such as damages is subject to civil court clarification and is beyond the influence of the federal government.
context: The committee majority defers responsibility for consumer remedies to civil courts rather than state enforcement, suggesting regulatory compliance standards had been met.

label: Defects in testing procedure itself, not manufacturer behavior
original_label: Defects in testing procedure itself, not manufacturer behavior
quote: Angesichts der Komplexität der Motorsteuerung ist ein Ausschlussverfahren im Checklistenprinzip nicht möglich. Zur Bewertung der Zulässigkeit ist in jedem Einzelfall die Offenlegung der Emissionsminderungsstrategie und Prüfung erforderlich.
english_gloss: Given the complexity of engine control, an exclusion procedure based on a checklist principle is not possible. To assess admissibility, the disclosure and examination of the emissions reduction strategy is required in each individual case.
context: The committee majority attributes the inability to detect violations to inherent technical complexity rather than regulatory negligence or manufacturer deception.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Operating within statutory authority to verify compliance
original_label: Operating within statutory authority to verify compliance
quote: Das von der Untersuchungskommission "Volkswagen" und dem Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt gewählte Weg war daher nach Überzeugung des Ausschusses sachgerecht. Das Vorgehen erfolgte nach dem Ergebnis der Beweisaufnahme zu allerletzt mit Rücksicht auf die Hersteller, es diente vielmehr in erster Linie den Interessen der Halter der betroffenen, kurzfristig verbesserten Fahrzeuge und den Belangen des Umwelt- und Gesundheitsschutzes.
english_gloss: The path chosen by the 'Volkswagen' investigation commission and the Motor Vehicle Authority was therefore appropriate according to the committee's conviction. According to the results of the hearing, the procedure was carried out least of all with consideration for the manufacturers; rather, it primarily served the interests of owners of the affected vehicles quickly improved and the concerns of environmental and health protection.
context: The committee majority defends the voluntary recall approach rather than mandatory enforcement as legally appropriate and consumer-protective.

label: Uncertainty in evidence permits leniency
original_label: Uncertainty in evidence permits leniency
quote: Angesichts der Unklarheit des europäischen Rechts insbesondere bezogen auf den Ausnahmetatbestand des "Motorschutzes" und das Kriterium der "normalen Betriebsbedingungen" ist jedoch bis heute eine rechtssichere Beweisführung im Sinne einer eindeutigen Feststellung der Zulässigkeit oder Unzulässigkeit nicht möglich.
english_gloss: However, given the lack of clarity in European law, particularly regarding the exception for 'engine protection' and the criterion of 'normal operating conditions,' even today it is not possible to provide legally binding proof in the sense of a clear determination of admissibility or inadmissibility.
context: The investigation commission argues that legal uncertainty about which devices qualify as permitted exceptions justifies not assigning definitive wrongdoing.

category: Moral justification and appeal to higher loyalties
label: Speed of RDE implementation needed to protect environment
original_label: Speed of RDE implementation needed to protect environment
quote: Mit RDE wird erstmals und weltweit einmalig für den Erhalt einer Typgenehmigung vom Gesetz als Bedingung vorausgesetzt, dass die festgelegten Abgasgrenzwerte nicht nur auf dem Rollenprüfstand, sondern auch im realen Fahrbetrieb eingehalten werden müssen. Deutschland war dabei stets ein Antreiber bei der Erarbeitung dieses neuen Prüfverfahrens für den realen Fahrbetrieb.
english_gloss: With RDE, for the first time globally, it is required by law as a condition for obtaining type approval that the specified emission limit values must be complied with not only on the test stand but also in real driving conditions. Germany was consistently a driving force in developing this new real-world driving emissions testing procedure.
context: The committee majority praises Germany's role in developing real-world emissions testing to justify its regulatory approach as environmentally motivated.

label: Manufacturers' technical strategies versus fraud
original_label: Manufacturers' technical strategies versus fraud
quote: Im Rahmen der Untersuchungen andere technische Verfahren identifiziert, mit denen die Hersteller die Wirksamkeit ihres Emissionskontrollsystems an Fahr- und Umweltbedingungen anpassen, was sich in einer großen Bandbreite der im Labor- und Realbetrieb gemessenen NOx-Emissionswerte widerspiegelt.
english_gloss: In the course of investigations, other technical procedures were identified with which manufacturers adjust the effectiveness of their emission control systems to driving and environmental conditions, which is reflected in a wide range of NOx emission values measured in the laboratory and in real-world operation.
context: The investigation commission describes systematic emissions manipulation as neutral 'technical strategies' for adaptation rather than cheating.

label: Manufacturers not compelled to disclose engine software
original_label: Manufacturers not compelled to disclose engine software
quote: Eine Verpflichtung der Genehmigungsbehörde, während jedes Genehmigungsprozesses Einblick in die gesamte Motorsteuerungssoftware zu nehmen, hält der Ausschuss hingegen nicht für regelmäßig erforderlich und unverhältnismäßig aufwendig.
english_gloss: The committee, however, does not consider it to be a regular requirement or disproportionately burdensome for the approval authority to have access to the entire engine control software during each approval process.
context: The committee majority argues that full software disclosure cannot reasonably be demanded, implicitly limiting the state's investigative capacity.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: RDE regulations include strict protections against manipulation
original_label: RDE regulations include strict protections against manipulation
quote: Mit der Einführung von RDE in vier Paketen haben sich die politisch Verantwortlichen eindeutig gegen die Wünsche der Automobilhersteller gestellt.
english_gloss: With the introduction of RDE in four packages, those politically responsible have clearly positioned themselves against the wishes of automobile manufacturers.
context: The committee majority argues that strict new RDE standards prove policymakers resisted industry pressure, validating the prior approach.

label: Older study findings not applicable to newer vehicle classes
original_label: Older study findings not applicable to newer vehicle classes
quote: Hinweise, dass ebenfalls VW-Fahrzeuge mit Motoren der Baureihe EA 288 (Euro 6) von Abgasmanipulationen betroffen seien, haben sich im Zuge der Überprüfungen als unbegründet erwiesen.
english_gloss: Indications that VW vehicles with engines from the EA 288 series (Euro 6) were also affected by emissions manipulation proved to be unfounded in the course of investigations.
context: The investigation commission minimizes violations by noting that only older emission standards were affected, not the newest vehicles.

label: Automakers test themselves under agency oversight
original_label: Automakers test themselves under agency oversight
quote: Stattdessen testen die Autohersteller selbst, ob ihre Fahrzeuge ordnungsgemäß funktionieren. Tatsächlich prüft das Kraftfahrt-Bundesamt lediglich die Prüfungsunterlagen der Hersteller.
english_gloss: Instead, automakers test whether their vehicles function properly. In fact, the Federal Motor Vehicle Authority only reviews the test documentation of the manufacturers.
context: The report states that automakers conduct their own testing while the KBA only reviews the documentation, describing the structural delegation of testing responsibility.

label: State authority relies on manufacturer self-certification
original_label: State authority relies on manufacturer self-certification
quote: Die Praxis war eine Selbstüberprüfung durch die Hersteller, überprüft oder gemonitort durch ein Typgenehmigungsbehörde.
english_gloss: The practice was self-checking by manufacturers, monitored by a type approval authority.
context: Environmental Ministry witness describing how in-use compliance was handled: manufacturers self-checked, with only monitoring by the type approval authority.

label: No concrete danger found in higher emissions
original_label: No concrete danger found in higher emissions
quote: Wir kamen zu dem Ergebnis, dass eine konkrete Gefahr, die nach dieser Vorschrift verlangt werden muss, nicht besteht, ja.
english_gloss: We came to the conclusion that a concrete danger, as required by this regulation, does not exist.
context: Dr. Frank Albrecht of the BMVI testified that the government concluded no concrete danger existed from higher real-world emissions when evaluating whether to order a recall.

label: Critics blamed for unrealistic demands on industry
original_label: Critics blamed for unrealistic demands on industry
quote: Auch sollte das neue Verfahren erst ein Jahr später in Kraft treten. Auch die Abgasgrenzwerte sollten massiv aufgeweicht werden, denn alles andere sei für 'für die Automobilindustrie unerreichbar'.
english_gloss: The new procedure should only take effect a year later. The emission limits should also be massively weakened, because anything else would be 'unreachable for the automotive industry'.
context: The Bavarian State Chancellery, representing BMW interests, argued that implementation should be delayed and limits weakened because compliance was 'unreachable for the automotive industry.'

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Thermofensters compliant with broad regulatory language
original_label: Thermofensters compliant with broad regulatory language
quote: Ja. Ich würde sagen, die haben alle die Richtlinie eingehalten, weil die Richtlinie so ein großes Scheunentor ist.
english_gloss: Yes. I would say they all complied with the directive because the directive is such a big barn door.
context: Prof. Wachtmeister from the Investigation Commission testifying that thermofenster devices complied because the directive language was so broad.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Motorschutzmaßnahmen presented as legitimate exception
original_label: Motorschutzmaßnahmen presented as legitimate exception
quote: Viele Hersteller ließen die Abgasreinigung ihrer Fahrzeuge z. B. bei bestimmten Außentemperaturen – meist aus Kostengründen – einfach abstellen. Was zuvor in der Bundesregierung niemand gewusst haben will, wird nun vom Verkehrsminister als legal definiert, weil die Hersteller die Abschaltung der Abgasreinigung mit dem Motorschutz begründen.
english_gloss: Many manufacturers simply shut down emission control in their vehicles at certain outside temperatures—usually for cost reasons. What previously no one in the federal government wanted to know about is now defined as legal by the Transport Minister because manufacturers justify the shutdown of emission control as motor protection.
context: The report documents how the Transport Minister reframed emission control shutdowns as legally compliant when justified as motor protection, despite previously being unknown to government.

label: Manufacturer's prior safety record offered as absolution
original_label: Manufacturer's prior safety record offered as absolution
quote: Deswegen habe er folglich 'auch jedem Hersteller die Absolution erteilt'.
english_gloss: Therefore he consequently 'also granted absolution to every manufacturer'.
context: Prof. Wachtmeister stated he gave 'absolution to every manufacturer,' suggesting past compliance created credit for present conduct.

label: Cycle-beating disguised as normal technical strategy
original_label: Cycle-beating disguised as normal technical strategy
quote: Die moderne Fahrzeugelektronik ermöglicht es, die Fahrzeuge mit Einrichtungen auszustatten, die den Betrieb im NEFZ auf dem Rollenprüfstand erkennen, so dass auf ein für die Abgas-und/oder Verbrauchsmessung optimiertes Motorkennfeld umgeschaltet wird, das vom normalen Betrieb abweicht (sog. cycle-beating).
english_gloss: Modern vehicle electronics make it possible to equip vehicles with devices that recognize the NEFZ test procedure on the dynamometer, so that a motor map optimized for emissions and/or consumption measurement is switched to, which deviates from normal operation (so-called cycle-beating).
context: The Environmental Federal Agency's 2008 proposal for field testing described cycle-beating using technical terminology that obscures its manipulative nature.

label: Type approval authority duty but no investigation mandate
original_label: Type approval authority duty but no investigation mandate
quote: In § 24 des Verwaltungsverfahrensgesetz (VwVfG) ist der Untersuchungsgrundsatz verankert. Dort heißt es: 'Die Behörde ermittelt den Sachverhalt von Amts wegen. Sie bestimmt Art und Umfang der Ermittlungen'. Über diesen Grundsatz kann auch eine Überprüfung auf illegale Manipulationen erfolgen. In den Sitzungen des Untersuchungsausschusses haben die Vertreter des Kraftfahrt-Bundesamtes jedoch bestritten, diese Kompetenzen zu besitzen.
english_gloss: The investigative principle is anchored in Section 24 of the Administrative Procedure Act. It states: 'The authority investigates the facts ex officio. It determines the type and scope of investigations.' Through this principle, an inspection for illegal manipulations can also occur. However, in the meetings of the investigative committee, representatives of the Federal Motor Vehicle Authority disputed having these competencies.
context: The report shows KBA representatives denied having the legal authority to investigate manipulations despite administrative law granting such authority.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: Rigid regulatory framework prevents investigation
original_label: Rigid regulatory framework prevents investigation
quote: weil wir ein relativ starres Regelwerk und Korsett haben hinsichtlich der technischen Prüfungen, die wir machen können, sowohl die Prüfungen, die der Hersteller vorlegt, um eben eine Genehmigung zu erhalten, als auch die Nachprüfungen, die wir machen.
english_gloss: because we have a relatively rigid regulatory framework and corset regarding the technical tests we can conduct, both the tests the manufacturer submits to obtain approval and the re-tests we conduct.
context: KBA official Sven Paeslack blamed the rigid regulatory framework for inability to investigate beyond standard test cycles, deflecting responsibility to the rules.

label: Single anomaly not requiring investigation
original_label: Single anomaly not requiring investigation
quote: Für mich ergibt sich hieraus nicht die Notwendigkeit weiterer Fragestellungen an die VW AG.
english_gloss: For me, this does not result in the necessity for further questions to VW AG.
context: KBA official dismissed elevated NOx values in a VW Golf test as a single case not warranting further inquiry of the manufacturer.

label: CO2 aberration attributed to test limitations
original_label: CO2 aberration attributed to test limitations
quote: Da die CO2-Ermittlung nicht direkter Bestandteil des Projektes ist und letztlich auch hier nur das stat. Verfahren ausreichend Klärung hinsichtlich Produktionsmangel bringen kann, ist meine Empfehlung, derzeit keine weitere Klärung von VW abzuverlangen.
english_gloss: Since CO2 determination is not a direct part of the project and ultimately only the statistical method can provide sufficient clarification regarding production defects, my recommendation is to currently make no further inquiries of VW.
context: KBA staff member recommending no follow-up with VW when CO2 measurements showed anomalies, characterizing the issue as outside the project scope.

label: Field testing blocked by transportation ministry reluctance
original_label: Field testing blocked by transportation ministry reluctance
quote: Eine unabhängige Überprüfung der Kraftfahrzeuge durch eine Verkehrsbehörde war insofern in gewisser Weise Neuland. Und dieses Neuland zu beschreiten, bedurfte einer gewissen Aktivierungsenergie.
english_gloss: Independent inspection of motor vehicles by a transportation authority was in a certain sense new territory. And to venture into this new territory required a certain activation energy.
context: Environmental Ministry witness explaining that the transportation ministry required special political effort to engage in field testing of vehicles.

label: Field monitoring redesigned away from fraud detection
original_label: Field monitoring redesigned away from fraud detection
quote: Was vom Umweltbundesamt als kontinuierliche und umfassende Feldüberwachung angelegt war, war letztlich ein einmaliges Projekt mit nur wenigen Fahrzeugen. Die Prüfung auf Konstruktionsteile für das Cycle Beating wurde dabei gestrichen. Zudem wurden die Fahrzeuge nicht abseits des NEFZ getestet, sondern nur nach diesem offiziellen Prüfverfahren – also genau der Test, bei dem die VW-Fahrzeuge manipulieren konnten.
english_gloss: What was originally designed by the Environmental Federal Agency as continuous and comprehensive field monitoring became ultimately a one-time project with only a few vehicles. The inspection for cycle-beating components was eliminated. Moreover, vehicles were not tested outside the NEFZ, but only according to this official test procedure—precisely the test where VW vehicles could manipulate.
context: The report documents how the comprehensive field monitoring proposal was gutted: cycle-beating checks were removed, and vehicles were tested only under the NEFZ—the very test manipulated by VW.

label: Environmental ministry blamed for unrealistic proposals
original_label: Environmental ministry blamed for unrealistic proposals

original_label: High NOx values deemed not sufficiently explained

original_label: Conformity factors framed as technical measurement margins

original_label: Complex accounting devices disguising fraud

label: Gap, stretch, overview for earnings shortfall
original_label: Gap, stretch, overview for earnings shortfall

context: The indictment shows how Enron insiders used neutral-sounding code words for the massive fraudulent adjustments they were making.

label: Efficiency maneuver concealing massive losses
original_label: Efficiency maneuver concealing massive losses
quote: In public statements to securities analysts and others, SKILLING CAUSEY and others acting at their direction explained the change in segment reporting solely as a means to improve efficiency. context: The indictment describes how executives mischaracterized the reorganization of EES as an efficiency measure when its true purpose was to hide hundreds of millions in losses.

label: Asset parking and warehousing arrangement
original_label: Asset parking and warehousing arrangement

label: Nonrecurring losses masking systematic fraud
original_label: Nonrecurring losses masking systematic fraud
quote: Enron misleadingly described the hundreds of millions of dollars in losses stemming from the 'unwind,' or abandonment, of the 'Raptors' as 'nonrecurring' losses, that is, a one-time or unusual earnings event. However, as defendant RICHARD A. CAUSEY well knew, over the course of prior quarters, Enron had characterized the positive earnings that it previously recognized, and then hedged, from these same assets as ordinary operating earnings that could be expected to recur.
context: The indictment shows how Causey and others used the term 'nonrecurring' to mislead analysts about the systematic nature of Enron's accounting fraud.

label: Board approval for LJM partnership creation
original_label: Board approval for LJM partnership creation
quote: In June 1999, in order to have a purportedly independent third party available to provide this outside equity funding so that Enron could more easily create and use SPEs to achieve its desired financial reporting results, defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and others sought and obtained the approval of Enron's Board of Directors (the 'Board') for CFO Fastow to create and serve as the managing partner of an investment partnership named LJM1 that would invest in SPEs for Enron.
context: The indictment shows how Skilling and Causey obtained board approval as a means to legitimize the LJM structure used for fraudulent off-balance-sheet accounting.

label: Auditor signed off on transactions
original_label: Auditor signed off on transactions
quote: As defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY well knew, LJM was not a legitimate third party acting independently from Enron. Instead, LJM was controlled by Fastow acting simultaneously in his capacity both as Enron's CFO and as the general partner in LJM. SKILLING, CAUSEY, Fastow and others then exploited Fastow's dual role as a means to ensure that LJM did not act as a truly independent third party investor would have, but rather as Enron's own vehicle to achieve its financial reporting objectives and as a means for Fastow and others to be heavily compensated for contributing to Enron's success in meeting its financial reporting objectives.
context: The indictment reveals that Skilling and Causey displaced responsibility by using the appearance of LJM independence and third-party structures, relying implicitly on auditor approval.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: Together with coconspirators decision-making
original_label: Together with coconspirators decision-making
quote: Defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY conspired with numerous Enron executives and senior managers in the scheme to defraud described in this Superseding Indictment. The coconspirators included, but were not limited to, former Enron CFO Andrew S. Fastow, who was a supervisor of such matters as Enron's structured finance, cash flow, and debt management activities; former Enron Treasurer Ben F. Glisan, Jr., who reported to SKILLING and, at times, Fastow and also was a supervisor of Enron's structured finance, cash flow and debt management activities; former Enron North America ('ENA') and Enron Energy Services ('EES') CEO David W. Delainey, who reported to SKILLING and was a supervisor of the largest part of Enron's wholesale energy business and, later, of its retail energy business; former ENA CAO Wesley Colwell, who reported to CAUSEY and Delainey and managed the accounting for Enron's wholesale energy business; former Enron Global Finance Managing Director Michael Kopper, who reported to Fastow and conducted structured finance activities for Enron; and others.
context: The indictment describes how Skilling and Causey diffused responsibility by organizing a network of coconspirators, each with specific subordinate roles, making it harder to pin individual accountability.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: Senior executive directed reserve manipulation
original_label: Senior executive directed reserve manipulation
quote: In order to help achieve the earnings-per-share target that defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY wanted to report publicly, a senior Enron executive improperly released into earnings millions of dollars from a 'prudency' reserve account in Enron's energy trading business, which purportedly existed so that Enron would not report more energy trading earnings than it actually expected to collect. This release of millions of dollars from the prudency reserve account was not done for legitimate business or accounting objectives. It was done solely to accomplish defendants SKILLING's and CAUSEY'S desire to publicly report a higher earnings per share number than expected by securities analysts for the second quarter 2000, and thereby artificially inflate and support Enron's share price.
context: The indictment describes how Skilling and Causey distanced themselves by having 'a senior Enron executive' implement the reserve manipulation, diffusing personal responsibility.

category: Diffusion of responsibility and denial of personal involvement
label: Restructuring decision attributed to efficiency
original_label: Restructuring decision attributed to efficiency
quote: A senior Enron manager also misled analysts about the movement of EES's energy contracting portfolio into Enron Wholesale, stating, 'We just took the risk management functions and combined them because we just -- we were trying to get some more efficiency out of management of the overall risk management function.'
context: The indictment quotes a senior manager diffusing responsibility for the reorganization by attributing it to a collective effort for efficiency rather than individual decision-making.

label: California market impact characterized as minimal
original_label: California market impact characterized as minimal

He further stated that 'nothing can happen in California that would jeopardize' Enron's earnings targets for 2001 and that California business was 'small' for Enron.
context: The indictment shows Skilling minimizing the actual massive profitability and associated risks from California energy trading that Enron was hiding in reserve accounts.

label: EBS revenue generation characterized as minor
original_label: EBS revenue generation characterized as minor
quote: After being directed by defendant JEFFREY K. SKILLING to answer a question about the source of EBS's revenues, the senior manager said that one-time, nonrecurring transactions such as sales of 'dark fiber' and a 'monetization,' or sale, of part of EBS's nascent video-on-demand venture with the Blockbuster company accounted for only 'a fairly small amount' of EBS's revenues. In truth, as Enron executives and senior managers including defendant RICHARD A. CAUSEY well knew, the sale of projected future revenues from the Blockbuster video-on-demand venture, which Enron abandoned just a quarter later, accounted for $53 million of EBS's fourth quarter 2000 revenues of $63 million.
context: The indictment shows how Skilling directed mischaracterization of what actually comprised 84% of EBS revenues as merely 'a fairly small amount,' minimizing the true state of EBS's business.

label: EES losses and California receivables concealed
original_label: EES losses and California receivables concealed
quote: While Enron reported modest first quarter earnings for EES of $40 million, in reality, as SKILLING well knew, EES was facing losses approaching one billion dollars, including overvalued contracts, uncollectible receivables with the California utilities, and huge costs from an increased California regulatory surcharge.
context: The indictment describes Skilling's minimization of catastrophic EES losses as he characterized them as producing 'big, big numbers' of positive earnings.

label: Sophisticated investors should have known
original_label: Sophisticated investors should have known
quote: Relying in part on the company's guidance, securities analysts disseminated to the public their own estimates of the company's expected performance. These earnings estimates, or analysts' expectations, were closely followed by investors.
context: While not a direct statement by the defendants, the indictment's framing of investor sophistication and analyst intermediation could suggest victims should have been more careful, though the document itself does not frame this as a defendant excuse.

label: Investors as statistics and market mechanics
original_label: Investors as statistics and market mechanics
quote: Due to the efforts of defendants JEFFREY K. SKILLING and RICHARD A. CAUSEY and their coconspirators, Enron's publicly reported financial results and filings and its public descriptions of itself, including in public statements made by or with the knowledge of SKILLING and CAUSEY, did not truthfully present the financial position, results from operations, and cash flow of the company and omitted to disclose facts necessary to make the disclosures and statements that were made truthful and not misleading. As a consequence, the financial appearance of Enron that SKILLING, CAUSEY and their coconspirators presented to the investing public concealed the real Enron.
context: The indictment's language treats investors as abstract entities to be manipulated through financial metrics rather than people with real interests, though this reflects the prosecutors' characterization rather than the defendants' own voice.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Off-balance-sheet accounting under GAAP rules
original_label: Off-balance-sheet accounting under GAAP rules
quote: Under applicable accounting rules, if a company conducted a transaction with an SPE that included at least a three-percent equity investment that was at risk and from an independent source, a company could, under certain conditions, treat the results of such a transaction as 'deconsolidated,' or excluded, from its own financial results. This meant that a company could record the earnings and cash flow from such a deal in its own results, but did not have to record liabilities such as debt in the transaction on its own balance sheet.
context: The indictment describes how Enron executives used technical compliance with specific accounting rules as the basis for transactions designed to defraud, treating formal rules as morally settling.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Raptor structure initially designed within accounting rules
original_label: Raptor structure initially designed within accounting rules
quote: They designed and approved Raptor I, among other things, to protect Enron from having to report publicly in its financial results decreases in value in large portions of its energy merchant asset portfolio and technology investments by hedging the value of those investments with an allegedly independent third party created by Enron and LJM, known as Talon.
context: The indictment shows how the Raptor structure was framed as a hedge designed within technical accounting parameters, using formal compliance to justify what was actually fraudulent.

category: Appeal to legality and technical compliance
label: Representation letters falsely certifying GAAP compliance
original_label: Representation letters falsely certifying GAAP compliance
quote: Specifically, while agreeing that they were responsible for the fair presentation of the financial statements, SKILLING and CAUSEY falsely represented to Enron's accountants that, among other things, (a) the financial statements were presented in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles; (b) Enron properly recorded or disclosed in its financial statements guarantees, whether written or oral, under which Enron was contingently liable
context: The indictment shows how Skilling and Causey falsely invoked GAAP compliance in representation letters to auditors, treating technical accounting standards as settling the moral and legal questions.

category: Moral justification and appeal to higher loyalties
label: Meeting growth targets for shareholders
original_label: Meeting growth targets for shareholders
quote: The scheme's objectives were, among other things, to report recurring earnings that falsely appeared to grow smoothly by approximately 15 to 20 percent annually; to meet or exceed the published expectations of securities analysts forecasting Enron's reported earnings-per-share and other results; to conceal and avoid publicly reporting any large 'write-downs' or losses; to persuade investors through false and misleading statements that Enron's profitability would continue to grow; to deceive credit rating agencies in order to maintain an investment-grade credit rating; to deceive the investing public about the true magnitude of growing debt and other obligations required to keep the company's varied and often unsuccessful business ventures afloat; to increase artificially Enron's reported cash flow in order to mask a growing disparity between the company's reported revenues and its actual earnings from operations; and to artificially inflate the share price of Enron's stock.
context: The indictment describes the implicit appeal to shareholder value creation and growth targets as justifications for the fraudulent accounting scheme.

category: Moral justification and appeal to higher loyalties
label: Maintaining credit rating for business continuity
original_label: Maintaining credit rating for business continuity
quote: It was critical to Enron's ongoing business operations that it maintain an investment grade rating for its debt, which was rated by national rating agencies, An investment grade rating was essential to Enron's ability to enter into trading contracts with its counterparties and to maintain sufficient lines of credit with major banks.
context: The indictment describes how maintaining the credit rating was framed as necessary for the company's survival and operations, serving as an implicit justification for fraudulent accounting.

category: Moral justification and appeal to higher loyalties
label: EBS dot-com premium strategy for stock valuation
original_label: EBS dot-com premium strategy for stock valuation
quote: Beginning in 1999, defendant JEFFREY K. SKILLING and others sought artificially to support and inflate Enron's stock price by falsely characterizing Enron as a company whose earnings and future prospects were determined to a substantial extent by its telecommunications business, EBS. At that time, stocks of technology sector companies, commonly known as 'dot-coms,' generally traded at a significant premium on public securities markets. SKILLING and others referred to this plan as giving 'dot-corn luster' to Enron's share price.
context: The indictment shows how Skilling justified the false promotion of EBS as necessary to capture market valuation premiums, appealing to competitive positioning in the technology sector.

original_label: Manufacturer relying on approval by regulators

original_label: Minimizing defect prevalence by percentage
